text: {"lessons":["With no trades, my account still rose and fell; short-term price moves are uncertain and past changes do not reliably predict what comes next.","I should judge the portfolio as a whole rather than treating each stock as a separate account or focusing only on whether it is above my purchase price.","I rarely check or trade, so I should avoid reacting to brief fluctuations and make decisions deliberately, while recognizing that inaction is also a choice."]}
